fun_facts: Ian Thomas is from Baltimore, Maryland.
He began at Nassau Community College playing basketball, then returned to football and transferred to Indiana as a junior.
In his second season at Indiana, Ian Thomas caught 25 passes, up from three in his first season.
As a rookie in 2018, Ian Thomas made 36 catches for 333 yards and two touchdowns.
During the 2018 draft, NFL analyst Daniel Jeremiah compared Ian Thomas to Antonio Gates.

basis.reasoning: The player biography identifies Ian Thomas's college as Indiana.

excerpts:
Besides losing his parents at a young age, he wasn't recruited by a Division I team out of Digital Harbor High School (Baltimore) and wound up at Nassau Community College -- initially for basketball.

He ultimately found his way back to football and transferred to Indiana as a junior. He caught only three passes his first season and 25 this past year, but showed enough athletic prowess to impress NFL coaches and general managers.
citations.title: Panthers rookie Ian Thomas showed perseverance on path to NFL - ESPN - Carolina Panthers Blog- ESPN

excerpts:
It’s a very strong deal for Thomas, who is coming off an 18-catch 188-yard season in 2021.

New offensive coordinator Ben McAdoo’s system leans on the tight end position, particularly blocking. The deal indicates the Panthers clearly view Thomas as an ideal fit.

In four years with the Panthers after becoming a fourth-round pick in 2018, Thomas has generated 90 catches for 802 yards and four TDs. The Indiana product got off to a strong start as a rookie, netting 333 yards and two TDs with 36 receptions. He hasn’t come close to those figures the past three years but is a stellar blocking TE.

Thomas and [Tommy Tremble](https://www.nfl.com/players/tommy-tremble/) , a 2021 third-round pick, project as the Panthers' top tight ends heading into 2022.

excerpts:
The [Panthers](https://www.nfl.com/teams/carolinapanthers/profile?team=CAR) kicked off Day 3 of the draft by nabbing tight end [Ian Thomas](https://www.nfl.com/prospects/ian-thomas?id=32462018-0002-5598-49c6-a898fedcd981) out of Indiana at No. 101 overall in the fourth round Saturday.

Thomas is an uber-athletic, pass-catching tight end who drew comparisons to [Antonio Gates](https://www.nfl.com/player/antoniogates/2505299/profile) from NFL Media draft expert Daniel Jeremiah.

"He's got athletic traits and upside," said fellow draft sage Mike Mayock, who praised Thomas as a "very physical" specimen who has teams "intrigued by his upside."
